title: Servicing Fee Schedule: Grace Period, Late Fee and Returned-Payment Fee by Tier
content:
Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts carry the tier figures below for late installments and returned payments: the grace period, the late fee percentage of the monthly payment with its minimum and maximum, the goodwill late fee waivers allowed in any rolling 12 months, and the returned-payment fee.

| Tier | Grace days after a due date | Late fee percentage of the monthly payment | Minimum late fee (USD) | Maximum late fee (USD) | Goodwill late fee waivers per rolling 12 months | Returned-payment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 10 | 5 | 15.00 | 50.00 | 0 | 25.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 10 | 5 | 15.00 | 50.00 | 1 | 25.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 10 | 5 | 15.00 | 50.00 | 1 | 25.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 10 | 5 | 15.00 | 50.00 | 1 | 25.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 10 | 5 | 15.00 | 50.00 | 2 | 25.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 10 | 5 | 15.00 | 50.00 | 2 | 25.00 |

Grace days are calendar days counted after the due date.

## Points of reading

- The grace days (10), the late fee percentage (5), the minimum late fee (15.00), the maximum late fee (50.00) and the returned-payment fee (25.00) are the same at every tier.
- The goodwill late fee waiver allowance is the one figure on this schedule that differs by tier: none at Tier E, 1 at Tier D, Tier C and Tier B, and 2 at Tier A and Tier A+.
